{{Infobox/Generic |title=Chocolate Egg |image=Breakfast Egg.png{{!}}Breakfast Egg¦Breakfast Egg.png{{!}}Brunch Egg¦Lunch Egg.png{{!}}Lunch Egg¦Lunch Egg.png{{!}}Déjeuner Egg¦Dinner Egg.png{{!}}Dinner Egg¦Dinner Egg.png{{!}}Supper Egg }} During [[Hoppity's Hunt]], '''Chocolate Eggs''' will randomly spawn around the world. They are announced in chat as they appear. == Mechanics == Players can search manually or use an {{Item|Egglocator}} to locate them. Once found, they can be clicked to claim a random [[Chocolate Rabbit]]. A total of 6 eggs can be active at once, two of each time of day. When a new egg appears, the oldest existing one will disappear. Egg locations are consistent between servers and spawn at 7 AM, 2 PM, and 9 PM [[SkyBlock Time]]. When the player finds a chocolate egg, one of the following chat messages will be displayed with the location depending on the type of chocolate egg: {| class="wikitable" !Chocolate Egg !In-game Spawn Time !colspan="3"|Real-world Spawn Time !Message |- |Breakfast Egg |rowspan="2" class="ct"|7 AM |rowspan="2" class="ct"|XX:00:50 |rowspan="2" class="ct"|XX:20:50 |rowspan="2" class="ct"|XX:40:50 |{{Dialogue|&d&lHOPPITY'S HUNT &r&dYou found a &6Chocolate Breakfast Egg &f[Location message]&d!}} |- |Brunch Egg |{{Dialogue|&d&lHOPPITY'S HUNT &r&dYou found a &6Chocolate Brunch Egg &f[Location message]&d!}} |- |Lunch Egg |rowspan="2" class="ct"|2 PM |rowspan="2" class="ct"|XX:06:40 |rowspan="2" class="ct"|XX:26:40 |rowspan="2" class="ct"|XX:46:40 |{{Dialogue|&d&lHOPPITY'S HUNT &r&dYou found a &9Chocolate Lunch Egg &f[Location message]&d!}} |- |Déjeuner Egg |{{Dialogue|&d&lHOPPITY'S HUNT &r&dYou found a &9Chocolate Déjeuner Egg &f[Location message]&d!}} |- |Dinner Egg |rowspan="2" class="ct"|9 PM |rowspan="2" class="ct"|XX:12:30 |rowspan="2" class="ct"|XX:32:30 |rowspan="2" class="ct"|XX:52:30 |{{Dialogue|&d&lHOPPITY'S HUNT &r&dYou found a &aChocolate Dinner Egg &f[Location message]&d!}} |- |Supper Egg |{{Dialogue|&d&lHOPPITY'S HUNT &r&dYou found a &aChocolate Supper Egg &f[Location message]&d!}} |- |Hitman Egg |colspan="4" class="ct"|Rabbit Hitman |{{Dialogue|&d&lHOPPITY'S HUNT &r&dYou found a &cHitman Egg&d!}} |} === Hitman Egg === {{Main|Chocolate Factory#Rabbit_Hitman}} If any '''Chocolate Egg''' has been missed or skipped, a Rabbit Hitman will auto collect it to be opened later on as long as there is an available slot. After opening a Hitman Egg, {{Green|20}} minutes are added to the cooldown until it becomes available again. Hitman Eggs are able to collect unique location progress and [[Chocolate Rabbits#List_of_Rabbits|Resident Rabbits]] from other Islands. The cooldown can be redused by up to {{Green|25%}} from the {{Attr|Hitman Cooldown}} attribute. == Chocolate Rabbits == === Rabbit Chance === {{/Chance}} === Duplicate Rabbits === Having a full Rabbit Barn or getting duplicate Rabbits in the [[Chocolate Factory]] will give the player {{Chocolate}} based on the rarity of the Rabbit and the player's current Chocolate per Second. {| class="wikitable centertext" !Rarity !Base Amount
(seconds of production) |- |{{Common}} |150 |- |{{Uncommon}} |300 |- |{{Rare}} |750 |- |{{Epic}} |1,500 |- |{{Legendary}} |4,000 |- |{{Mythic}} |8,000 |- |{{Divine}} |15,000 |} In addition, each duplicate rabbit found gives {{Green|+10%}} of the base amount, up to {{Green|+100%}} at the 10th duplicate. Amount of [[Chocolate]] gained can also be increased with certain methods (additive): {| class="wikitable ct" ! Source ! Chocolate Boost |- |{{Item|Rabbit Pet|rarity=m}} |{{Green|33%}} |- |{{Light Purple|King}} Rabbit |{{Green|30%}} |} The formula is the following, where \text{Duplicates Found} is inclusive of the rabbit that you just found. Therefore, your first duplicate will already grant a 10% bonus on top of the base amount. \text{Chocolate Gained} = \text{Chocolate per Second} \times \text{Base Amount} \times (1 + \min(\text{Duplicates Found}, 10) \times 0.1) \times OtherMultipliers === Stray Rabbits === {{Main|Chocolate Factory#Stray Rabbits}} '''Stray Rabbit''' is guaranteed to appear in {{Green|30}} seconds after collecting an egg. It has a 10% (or {{Green|20%}} with {{Pink|Omega}} {{Mythic}} Rabbit) to be replaced with a [[Golden Rabbit]]. == Known Locations == All '''Chocolate Egg''' locations can be seen below. In-game, [[coordinates]] can be viewed by pressing {{Key|F3}} on the keyboard. {{CSB|id=locations|Show/Hide Locations}} {{CS|id=locations|mode=begin}} {{:Chocolate Eggs/List}} {{CS|mode=end}} == Trivia == * There are {{Green|10}} {{Common}} [[Chocolate Rabbits|chocolate rabbits]] which require claiming eggs at {{Green|15}} different spots in certain islands. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2024/April 9|version=none|Added '''Chocolate Eggs'''.}} |beta= {{History|0.20.1|Added '''Chocolate Eggs'''.}} }} == References == {{Reflist}}
